item.title: Iran live updates: 1st purported message from new supreme leader read on state TV
item.summary: Mojtaba Khamenei was chosen on Sunday to replace his father, Ali Khamenei, the former supreme leader, who was killed on the first day of the U.S.-Israeli strikes.

item.title: WATCH: FBI warns Iran could attack California with drones: Alert
item.summary: The FBI has warned police departments in California that Iran wants to retaliate for American attacks by launching offensive drones against the West Coast, according to an alert reviewed by ABC News.

item.title: WATCH: Crews battle intense barge fire in Delaware
item.summary: A massive fire erupted on an unmanned barge in New Castle, Delaware. Flames scorched through mounds of scrap metal as fire crew battled the flames for hours.
